'''Yevgeny Mikhailovich Berkovich''' ({{langx|ru|Евгений Михайлович Беркович}}; born October 6, 1945, [[Irkutsk]]) is a Russian-Jewish mathematician, publicist, historian of science and literature, publisher and editor.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://lavkapisateley.spb.ru/enciklopediya/|title=Lavkapisateley}}</ref>

He is the founder of the online portal "Notes on Jewish History", which publishes the journal of the same name and the almanac "Jewish Antiquity". He is also the founder and editor-in-chief of the journal "Seven Arts"<ref name="openstat7isk">{{cite web|title=Журнал «Семь искусств»|url=http://rating.openstat.com/site/2065620|website=rating.openstat.com|date=2018-06-25|access-date=2018-06-26|archive-date=2018-06-26|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180626030632/http://rating.openstat.com/site/2065620|url-status=live}}</ref> and the journal-newspaper "Workshop".<ref name="openstatMast">{{cite web|title=Журнал-газета «Мастерская»|url=http://rating.openstat.com/site/2310750|website=rating.openstat.com|date=2018-06-25|access-date=2018-06-26|archive-date=2018-06-26|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180626030845/http://rating.openstat.com/site/2310750|url-status=live}}</ref>

He is the author of the books "Notes on Jewish History"<ref>{{cite web|url=http://berkovich-zametki.com/Kiosk/ZamEvrIst.htm|title=Первое издание: издательство «Алекспресс», Ганновер, 2000, ISBN 3-00-006096-0, второе издание: издательство «Янус-К», Москва, 2000|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20081015223630/http://berkovich-zametki.com/Kiosk/ZamEvrIst.htm|archive-date=2008-10-15}} ISBN 5-8037-0051-7</ref> and "The Banality of Goodness: Heroes, the Righteous, and Other People in the History of the Holocaust: Notes on Twentieth-Century Jewish History",<ref>{{cite web|url=http://berkovich-zametki.com/Kiosk/BanDobra.htm|title=«Банальность добра. Герои, праведники и другие люди в истории Холокоста. Заметки по еврейской истории двадцатого века»|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080108053445/http://berkovich-zametki.com/Kiosk/BanDobra.htm|archive-date=2008-01-08}} (Москва: Янус-К, 2003. — 390 с.: с илл. — Твёрдый переплёт. — ISBN 5-8037-0143-2)</ref> "The Odyssey of Peter Pringsheim" (2013), "Antipodes: Albert Einstein and Philipp Lenard in the Context of Physics and History" (2014), and "The Revolution in Physics and the Fates of Its Heroes." Thomas Mann and the Physicists of the 20th Century (2017), The Revolution in Physics and the Fates of Its Heroes. Albert Einstein in the Focus of 20th-Century History (2018), Albert Einstein and the "Revolution of Prodigies": Essays on the Development of Quantum Mechanics and the Unified Field Theory (2021), Notes on Albert Einstein. Time, Science, Life (2025). Scriptwriter for the documentary film ''Questions to God''.<ref>Московская студия документальных фильмов «Параджаноф-фильм», 2006</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://berkovich-zametki.com/2006/Starina/Nomer8/Minkina1.htm|title=Елена Минкина, Евгений Беркович // Вечер вопросов // Беседа о новом документальном фильме про немцев, спасавших евреев в годы Холокоста|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080828121427/http://berkovich-zametki.com/2006/Starina/Nomer8/Minkina1.htm|archive-date=2008-08-28}} Альманах «[[Еврейская Старина]]», № 8 (44) Август 2006</ref>

==Biography==
He was born on October 6, 1945, in Irkutsk. His father, Mikhail Shaevich Berkovich, was a radio engineer (born 1917 in [[Ukraine]] – died 2001 in Moscow), and his mother, Alexandra Vladimirovna Senderova, was a historian (born 1924 in Miloslavichi, Belarus – died in 1980 in Moscow).

From 1946 to 1995, he lived, studied, and worked in Moscow.

He graduated from the [[Moscow State University Faculty of Physics|Physics Department]] of [[Moscow State University]] in 1968, earned a PhD in Physics and Mathematics (1973),<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://nlr.ru/e-case3/sc2.php/web_gak/lc/9214/113#pict |title=каталог РНБ |access-date=2018-09-08 |archive-date=2018-09-08 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180908093151/http://nlr.ru/e-case3/sc2.php/web_gak/lc/9214/113#pict |url-status=live }}</ref> and is a senior researcher and Doctor of Natural Sciences (Germany).

Since 1995, he has lived and worked in Hanover, Germany.

Publications on Jewish history, history of science and literature in the periodicals Novy Mir, Znamya, Neva, Inostrannaya Literatura, Voprosy Literatury, Chelovek, Studiya, 22, Lechaim, Vestnik (Baltimore) and many other publications in Russia, Ukraine, USA, Israel, Germany,<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://magazines.gorky.media/authors/b/evgenij-berkovich|title=Евгений Беркович.
